Checking Pathbuilder connection…

Open Pathbuilder in this browser and save once. Pathbridger adds the character and calculates its rolls automatically—no linking or second save needed. Future saves update the same character. Your first character is selected for Paizo; use “Use on Paizo” to switch later.

Advanced sync controls

Legacy detected saves can still be linked to a manual character here.

Use calculated rolls replaces matching manual overrides with the latest generated values. Other custom actions are kept. Review the action list and save to apply.

After each linked save, Pathbridger runs Pathbuilder’s exporters locally to refresh supported rolls. Automatic exports are intercepted before upload. Custom edits are preserved; unsupported versions, changed characters, and unresolved actions are flagged for review. Keep the saved character open until syncing finishes.

JSON import — fallback when automatic sync is unavailable

Normally, just save in Pathbuilder. Use this escape hatch if sync fails or you have an exported file. Read the JSON, review its actions below, then save the character manually.

Only rule names are sent to Nethys; your character sheet stays local. Matches are cached for seven days. Unsupported mechanics become linked references, not guessed rolls.

Review or customize actions

Confirm every bonus and damage formula against your sheet. Set agile to true for agile attacks. Use map: [-3,-6] for a custom penalty, or null for standard MAP. Use mapIncreases: 0 for non-attack checks, or a positive integer for how many attacks an action contributes (default 1). Missing damage stays blank. Importing a character with Esoteric Lore and Exploit Vulnerability adds those checks without MAP. Re-import and save to add newly supported actions to an older saved character.

Saved buffs

Toggle these under Buffs in each editor. Bonuses of the same type use the highest value for each roll. Toggles affect new completions only and reset on page reload.

Use check bonuses only when they apply to all your configured non-attack checks. AC, spell DCs, durations, defenses, and conditional effects are not automated. Keep your imported base rolls free of these temporary buffs to avoid counting them twice.

At the table

Pathbridger activates automatically in editable Paizo text boxes. Start [dice= (case-insensitive) to see actions, then type part of a name such as [dice=exploit. Press Tab or Enter to insert the complete roll. The /action shortcut also works. Arrow keys select; Escape dismisses. Each message is one turn. MAP comes from earlier labeled attack rolls before the cursor.

Deleting or inserting earlier attacks updates MAP for the next completion. Existing rolls retain their formulas. Recognized manual labels include Strike, Attack, Trip, Grapple, Shove, Disarm, Reposition, Escape, and Spell attack. Plain prose, damage rolls, and quoted rolls do not count. Special actions such as Double Slice need manual rolls.

Character data stays in this browser profile; enabled Nethys lookups send ability and item names. Linked saves made in Pathbuilder sync to this browser profile. Pathbridger does not modify inventory or independently access your Google Drive account.
